column1: # pn_edition_spelling.tsv - the edition upgrade's name respellings, for backfill_pn_surface.py.
# The name-slot backfill pairs a name slot with ABP's printed Greek by the slot's English name token;
# the Greek comes from bh_scrape.db, whose English labels are the OLD edition's spellings. Where the
# new edition respells a name (Jabish -> Jabesh, Jehoram -> Joram ...) the token no longer matches and
# the slot loses its Greek. Each row says: in THIS verse, the edition's token is printed in the scrape
# under these old token(s). Used ONLY for a slot the normal rules refused, and only when the result
# leaves every normally-paired slot in the verse as it was (backfill_pn_surface.py, pair_verse_listed).
# One row per verse + edition token. scrape_tokens: one token = all such refused slots in the verse;
# several (comma-separated) = one per refused slot, in position order (counts must agree, else unused).
# Source: STEP9-NAMESGAP v2 11/14 (DESIGN 9.116): per verse, built's refused token -> the label src keyed
# that slot on (COALESCE(english_head, english)), paired by position, else (slot shift) by the verse's
# remaining missing slot. Notes mark shape 2 (token/possessive) and shape 3 (a different English word).
